body.condition: For each validation fold \(I_\ell\), every nuisance, conditional-moment, OVS normal-signal, projection-coefficient, covariance, and comparator-loading evaluation used on that fold is measurable with respect to observations outside \(I_\ell\), except for the explicitly global empirical target-cell shares in the final ratio, which are handled by their displayed finite-dimensional expansion.

standard.name: Fixed-fold cross-fitting with explicit global ratio shares
